Day-of-year 311 sets ORDER only: group start index 311 % 3 = 2 (policy_regulation leads, then elections_public_opinion, then geopolitics; yesterday geopolitics led), and within each group the list starts at offset 311 % group_size in pool order (policy 15 -> 11: AI licensing first; elections 9 -> 5: political bot network first; geopolitics 10 -> 1: US China AI competition first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-06, so items published 11-06 (after the prior harvest) through 11-07 are in scope. Context: Saturday, four days after the US midterm Election Day, so expect fewer agency releases; weight Friday-evening US releases (court orders, agency bulletins posted 11-06 late), Asia-Pacific Saturday items (Korea, Japan, India, Philippines), and EU pre-meeting papers. Upcoming hooks (only official documents are new, previews are not): informal European Council in Dublin on AI 2026-11-13; lame-duck Congress returns mid-November (NDAA AI provisions); Meta's new commercial terms on AI scraping take effect 2026-11-20 (Norway and Brazil courts already suspended them; UK CMA probe open). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official post-election after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, 'AI was the big issue of the midterms' commentary. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
